topics.name: AI Creativity

perspectives.title: AI Creativity

representative_posts.author: sweetbee.vip
representative_posts.text: folks so busy worrying about the limits of creativity and originality in AI assisted projects, they forget humans have been silly little lazy plaigiarist copycats for centuries, with or without AI. almost like it's just another tool or somethin

representative_posts.author: kart0ffeldraws.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think my biggest problem with AI is that creativity is such a human thing. We've been doing it in some form or another for as long as we've been a species So off-loading that onto a computer just feels so wrong. We make art that reflects being human; a computer will never be able to do that

representative_posts.author: jendem74.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: AI sucks. When I see commercials made by AI it is amazing to me the lack of creativity and innovation and the annoying robot sound is enough to make me scream. I hate AI.

representative_posts.author: sailorplutoirl.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Y'know, the avatar ai situation just, really highlights the lack of creativity this administration has. Like, they just wanted to look cool with this without understanding what makes avatar cool and why it resonated with people. AI at least allows them to create narratives without question

representative_posts.author: captainblinky.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I don't support AI images or video, regardless of the message. They waste resources we need desperately if we're going to survive what's to come, while diminishing human creativity. If you can't make it yourself, find someone who can. People over machines.

representative_posts.author: sharai.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Those AI assholes claiming they are using AI to help Black and Brown kids realize their creativity 🌚 are back and trying to pay the girls for reviews. I’m never surprised anymore but I hope they know they are DOA.

Sports.name: Raid Splitting

perspectives.title: Raid Splitting
perspectives.summary: Alliance raids are split into two parts

representative_posts.author: sayaaoneko.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: not with you on this. I love alliance raids, I q for them for fun. it is four big boss fights with no q's in between. I like being immersed in content for 30-40 minutes. Now if I want to do an alliance raid it is 2 duties. most people will like it and I respect that but this change is not for me

representative_posts.author: faithcharge.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: surely the alliance raid changes will only make them take longer to complete in the long run, when they’re not fresh content. old alliance raids are typically like a 30-60m queue outside of the roulette. and now you have to do that twice.

representative_posts.author: whxmsy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: sorry im still thinking about how bad of a decision this is and how it completely misses the mark on why people actually leave alliance raids. because current expac alliance raid queues are actually fine

representative_posts.author: bizzybelle.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This MAY result in one half of a raid being dead weeks after release, and that is a shame, as they are supposed to be complete sections of the experience narratively, and I hope they address that and make it a more comfortable split.

representative_posts.author: battlelitanys.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i seeeee ok thst makes sense… i guess that’s cool then cos clearly they’re gonna stylise the raids themselves to fit around a shorter time frame so it should be more dramatic and cool……

representative_posts.author: whxmsy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: the people who leave alliance raids are not people who would otherwise want to do them and dont have time its people who want exp as fast as possible while doing the bare minimum of mechanics.

representative_posts.author: wannabeelf.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hard same. Although I did go to bed last night wondering if there's any point in my even unlocking the alliance raid series anymore. All splitting the raids in half does for me is double the amount of time I spend waiting in DPS queues.

representative_posts.author: grumbleroar.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I too am in favor of this. Like, lmao I dont wanna be trapped in an alliance raid for long er than i have to

representative_posts.author: coeurthas.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: thinking about the a-raid stuff that was announced and I'm kinda torn. queue times for some of them are SO. FUCKING BAD. so it would be nice to be able to run them once they're no longer current and have to suffer. on the other hand I PLAY THE MMO TO DO THE CONTENT...?

representative_posts.author: callmenoa.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The like one change I’m iffy on that they announced for Evercold is dividing up alliance raids. I assume it will only be for new raids going forward, not retroactive, but worry it will just exacerbate the “crystal tower problem” of people only queueing for the shortest ones

representative_posts.author: channfm.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’ve seen people say the alliance raid change is unnecessary and like ? It’s really not Do people not realise that some people don’t spend all day on the game They’ll complain about how ffxiv isn’t accessible and when they actually make it more accessible they don’t care

representative_posts.author: bizzybelle.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: but now there are just 2 raids to queue for and pray that one pops. If you want a certain piece of gear, you only run the half of the raid that one is in, and as AR gear goes, sometimes a lot of it sucks lmao.

representative_posts.author: dreadmanticore.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It really isn't, looking at that posts quotes... I really don't see the issue with it! Queue will be popping so fast! Complete part 1 of the raid, get a drink of water, stretch your legs, come back and do part 2! Idk why people are livid about this...

representative_posts.author: yourigath.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This expansion I wanted to run Vana'diel raids because I just love Vana'diel. But the simple thought of having to go through 15min of queue pulse 30-45 mins of raid to maybe get nothing... Yeah, no. The change is AMAZING

representative_posts.author: azure-kitty.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My only real concern is just the pacing break when doing story - new raid might have a logical stop point and build quests around it? But old raids don't have natural pause points storywise, so it just suck from story immersion perspective. Otherwise I have no strong opinions of the change 🤭

representative_posts.author: allaganlizard.etheirys.social
representative_posts.text: It defeats the purpose of the alliance raid to split them up. They were supposed to be longer more traditional MMO raids. This is just 2 normal raids with extra steps. The only problem was having to compete for drops with 23 other randos... and that was easily fixed.

representative_posts.author: bakubread.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It sounded to me like the Alliance Raid division is only going to be a thing going forward, not retroactive, so no probably not

representative_posts.author: mesadrburns.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I still have raid content to do but yes I have reached the end lol time to not spend money and never play again lmfao

representative_posts.author: cynisterash.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: My thoughts on the whole raid situation no one asked for lmao. Tl;dr it’s not as big a deal as folks make it out to be. Good for Yoshi P for having some fun with it.

representative_posts.author: dreadmanticore.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Really don't see the issue with splitting raids into 2 parts. If you really want the full experience, just queue for both halves ig idk.. Queue times probably won't be an issue with the DC changes anyway.

representative_posts.author: ranor.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Tbh nier raids i think only get complaints bc they're some of the only ones that aren't fully brain off lol

representative_posts.author: faithcharge.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: you’re just moving the time that you would’ve spent in the raid into sitting around waiting for a queue to pop

representative_posts.author: radelgirl.vanadiel.network
representative_posts.text: Since the eva raid trailer has the wunder.... If they set these raids post rebuild 2.0 I'm giving Yoshi-p a handshake because i feel that's going to make people maaaad lmao

representative_posts.author: bizzybelle.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I personally cannot attest to an AR run taking more than 30 minutes in recent times, but I know long runs happen and they are way too much. I do worry that splitting the raid up will make queue's longer outside of the initial release, because it will still take just as many people to run

representative_posts.author: resaae.vanadiel.network
representative_posts.text: Explorer mode in Alliance Raids (and Baldesion Arsenal!! I mean field ops dungeons as a whole)

arguments: splitting raids reduces queue time and makes them more accessible
splitting raids makes them less immersive and more frustrating to complete
splitting raids will lead to longer overall wait times outside of initial release
splitting raids defeats the purpose of traditional MMO raids

perspectives.summary: Patrick Stewart was a great person

representative_posts.author: funsizela.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart was a wonderful human being. He taught us to see the humanity in others, to cherish time, to laugh with ease, and follow the fucking prime directive. Cheers to an amazingly great life lived by an amazingly great human being.

representative_posts.author: bluizu.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i wasn't too clued into who patrick stewart was (not a star trek guy), but he seemed like a wonderful person and i do mourn the loss of another dot of kindness on the globe

representative_posts.author: ckaiadn.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rest in peace Sir Patrick Stewart 💙 Absolute legendary actor and had a great sense of humor.

representative_posts.author: shesharkattack.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rest in peace Patrick Stewart

representative_posts.author: broadiethornton.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart, I've just come to understand, has died. A fantastically gifted actor who will be remembered for decades to come on account of various roles he so skillfully occupied. Captain Picard. Professor X.

representative_posts.author: urokialreadyknow.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sir Patrick Stewart passed away at the age of 86. Here are just a few of his roles... #rip

representative_posts.author: decemberrain.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Man, not Patrick, damn. That one hits hard. Patrick Stewart was such a gentleman, the world feels less right without him in it. Mark, are you up on your checkups?

representative_posts.author: richarddominic.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Tonight has been a lot of reskeeting of positive Patrick Stewart. I’ve no special story or connection of my own. I’m just very, deeply sad that we’ve lost a good man a great actor and a beacon of hope. Professor X, Captain Picard, stand for a better world. So did Patrick Stewart. Salut, Mon Capitain

representative_posts.author: anniehzimmerman.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: 😔💔 Completely lost for words. Patrick Stewart is an incredible Actor. He will live on forever though his work & in all his family, friends & Fans hearts forever 💕. Rip Sir Patrick Stewart 🖖💐

representative_posts.author: darickr.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: All I can say is fuck the grim reaper and his fucked up priorities. I am proud to have met Sir Patrick Stewart, and to know he genuinely, expressly, loved my work the way I loved his. What a gutting loss.

representative_posts.author: ez-ez.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart has always been an actor I loved seeing no matter what role he played. In and out of film, he was inspiring, and it's sad to learn that he is gone.

representative_posts.author: monicaanneheart.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart died today. That is just one of those things that I thought was never going to happen. He made this world a better place...

representative_posts.author: trythisagain.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: RIP Patrick Stewart! It's been a hard month for old Star Trek actors.

representative_posts.author: johanlenaerts.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: RIP Patrick Stewart. You will forever be an inspiration to many across the globe, both in character and out.

representative_posts.author: benkeiser.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: What a life ❤️‍🩹 I got to hear Patrick Stewart speak before a screening of Logan at the 2017 Savannah Film Festival and he was effortlessly charming and unassumingly sincere. Rest in peace, Sir 🫡

representative_posts.author: anygoodfilms.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Our tribute to the late great Patrick Stewart as we take a look at his life and career.... #RIPPatrickStewart

representative_posts.author: larrin86.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For anyone who would like to honor both Patrick Stewart and the season 😱

representative_posts.author: elittlechild.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The character I’ll always remember Sir Patrick Stewart for is far less known but all the more special 💔🕊️💔🕊️

representative_posts.author: milopoint.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart was a Shakespearean-trained actor who suffered through some horrible television writing, so I guess I can suffer fools here in this purgatory.

representative_posts.author: toasty.cx
representative_posts.text: kind of heartwarming that I have seen so much love and support for Sir Patrick Stewart's legacy and career on the timeline, including statements from fellow actors and actresses, and yet not one person has posted a screenshot of the statement I'm sure Wil Wheaton's made I love you all for this 🩵🩵🩵

representative_posts.author: phoebe96.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sir Patrick Stewart was a gentleman ... something a certain orange boil will never be RIP Captain 🖖✨️

representative_posts.author: kq5.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In my 2 years on BS, today's the 1st time I've seen the top 2 trending topics the same, "Patrick Stewart dies". He was important, not just as a TV character who portrayed a fine example of humanity, but in real life he was an advocate for the downtrodden; women abused by men. A true hero. 💔🖖

representative_posts.author: gwiss.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I’m very grateful we got this awesome moment (in an otherwise crappy movie) before Patrick Stewart passed.

representative_posts.author: rivelbee.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Just found out about the terrible news, and my heart fucking sank ;-; Rest in peace Sir Patrick Stewart, we lost another legend today ;-; ❤️

representative_posts.author: audieklotz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Never knew much about Patrick Stewart beyond the stardom and am learning only now about his other career of working to protect women and children from domestic violence ❤️‍🩹

representative_posts.text: So many lovely quotes and clips of Patrick Stewart going up on this sad night

representative_posts.author: davidmastio.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: alapidis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The outpouring of love, memories and sadness, for the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart on Bluesky warms my heart.

representative_posts.author: gojirra.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Rest in peace Patrick Stewart. I need to go watch "The Inner Light" again. One of the best episodes of TNG, and a story that stays with you forever.

representative_posts.author: opheliaspectre.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart passing is really fucking me up He was part of my childhood when my sister and I only had the original X-Men dvd. We watched the fuck out of it. RIP Sir Patrick Stewart. You will be missed greatly.

representative_posts.author: dankmccoy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I wrote Sir Patrick Stewart into this Daily Show piece on a whim, and he actually agreed to it. He never even looked mildly perturbed at the amount of time he had to stand around in a foil-covered box. RIP to a man who was as good a sport as he was an actor.

representative_posts.author: jenlucpiquant.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart’s Greatest Picard Moments in STAR TREK

representative_posts.author: antheabutler.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm going to need a couple of days to get over Patrick Stewart being gone. I can't wrap my head around this

representative_posts.author: nolongersms.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I swear to god <redacted> - I'm in my sads about Patrick Stewart. Don't be offering me this. I just did a rewatch less than a couple of months ago.

representative_posts.author: brezwrites.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I never interviewed Patrick Stewart, sadly, but I want to join the outpouring of affection for him. Once, at an award season party at the San Vicente Bungalows I saw him grab onto a tree branch and start doing pull-ups. This was only a few years ago. He was formidable to the end.

representative_posts.author: effendancie.blacksky.app
representative_posts.text: On a whim, two dear Trekkie friends and I flew to Colorado in 2023 to see Patrick Stewart on his book tour. He recited my favorite sonnet (116) and told us to be braver. More than anything from that night, I’ll remember him as a consummate storyteller. Peace to you, Sir Patrick, and thanks.

perspectives.brief: People have strong feelings about candy.
perspectives.detail:
Candy Distribution argues that People have strong feelings about candy.

The posts defend it in their own words. @drspookyer.bsky.social writes, “Ready to hand out candy for trick-or-treaters” @annebornschein.bsky.social writes, “My parents had my sister when I was 15, and I remember being SO happy to take her around the neighborhood because it let me extend trick or treating past the age deemed socially acceptable, with no side-eyeing.” @dansolomon.com writes, “the liminal space between being kid and an adult is pretty emotionally confusing and imo happily giving candy to teens who come trick or treating is a very easy way to be nice in that moment”

Inside Candy Distribution, the posts are arguing one position rather than a stack of unrelated claims.

I hand out candy to trick-or-treaters
I give more candy to teenagers
I don't want to run out of candy for kids
